newsitem.title: CANADA: Euro-Nevada to issue C$78 mln in shrs.
newsitem.headline: Euro-Nevada to issue C$78 mln in shrs.

text.p: Euro-Nevada Mining Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it agreed to issue two million common shares at C$39 per share with an option to boost the issue to up to 2.6 million shares.
The shares will be issued by way of a short-form prospectus and is subject to required regulatory approvals.

Euro-Nevada said proceeds would be used to expand its presence in the Pacific Rim as well as for development and further exploration of its 50 percent share of the 25,500-acre Midas property in the Carlin Trend of northern Nevada.
